# QAMAR Blowdry Lounge — Dubai

> Women-only walk-in blow-dry lounge opening in Dubai in March 2027, off Sheikh Zayed Road (between Mall of the Emirates and DIFC; exact address announced before opening). No appointment: guests join a queue from their phone and every look on the menu takes 45 minutes or less. A private shower while the guest's outfit (dress, abaya, hijab) is steamed and lightly perfumed, then the blow-dry and a drink. Bilingual English / Arabic.

## Key facts
- Status: not open yet. Opening March 2027, Dubai.
- Women only, all-female team.
- Walk-in only, no appointment.
- Area: off Sheikh Zayed Road. Exact address to be announced.
- Planned hours: 8 AM to midnight (to be confirmed).
- Prices on the site are indicative, in AED.
